lines.t: It’s been awhile since I first looked up to the sky
It’s been awhile since I felt the peace that money just can’t buy
And it’s been awhile since I could look you in the eyes
And it’s been awhile since I hid behind my own foolish pride
And all the times I hit the bottom
You were the one who held my pain
Is how you loved me anyway
It’s been awhile since I could say that I was whole
It’s been awhile since I let your spirit guide my soul
And it’s been awhile since I felt like I was worth your grace
And it’s been awhile since I spent my time seeking your face
And all the times I hit the bottom
You were the one who held my pain
Is how you loved me anyway
And I cannot blame you for the times I walked away
I chose the dark, I chose the shame
But you took the cross and you carried all the blame
And you called me by my name...
[Melancholic, crying guitar solo in the style of Staind]
It’s been awhile since I first looked up to the sky
It’s been awhile since I fell to my knees and started to cry
